requirements.remaining: SkillOpt/RHO/SkillGen external results are reviewed and SkillOpt mock plumbing passed; the independent LangMem arm executed on 3/3 natural cases but returned zero durable candidates and zero identifier recall; the alternative Llama natural arm adds typed AttributeError/ValidationError failures rather than a passing memory path; the expanded two-model/two-harness, budget-repair, schema-first, schema-injected, family-disjoint broker, held-out, paired-statistical, and independent receipt/semantic-verification matrices show model/protocol sensitivity but no causal held-out Frankengate skill or memory benefit.

requirements.requirement: Test single and composed mechanisms against public traces
requirements.remaining: The two-harness Llama replay agrees on the protocol null; the two-model matrix shows strong model sensitivity and latency cost; held-out and budget/schema-first repairs expose typed nulls; schema injection reaches semantic evaluation but ties 1/6 across all arms; the family-disjoint broker transfer is 0/6 for no-skill and trace-mined versus one placebo success; the true mined candidate transfer repeats 0/6 for no-skill and trace-mined versus 1/6 placebo; independent receipt and semantic verifiers pass. Human labels, changed-system task outcomes, and a larger enterprise causal estimate remain incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Test governed local Aurora-like storage and authorization
requirements.remaining: Atomic lifecycle procedures, planner readiness, and the FinanceBench forced-RLS/vector/deletion replay pass local rollback, denial, redacted-plan, and post-ANALYZE checks; Aurora failover, RDS Proxy, replica lag, PITR, scale, and continuous-revocation semantics remain unverified.
Raw trajectory shard access requires publisher approval; no CMU metrics may be claimed.

requirements.requirement: Record reproducible results in GitHub issues, beads, and a pushed branch
requirements.remaining: Open beads remain for incomplete scientific gates.

FinanceBench shows a strong finance-specialized embedding relevance signal (Recall@20 1.000 versus Qwen3 0.993 and TF-IDF 0.687), while the same-projection loopback nomic arm reaches only 0.453. The local governed replay now proves policy-before-ranking, deletion filtering, and rollback for the BalyasnyAI arm, but this is still public relevance and local mechanics, not enterprise adaptation. Human hard-negative labels, disjoint adaptation folds, latency/cost, held-out transfer, Aurora behavior, and memorization checks remain missing against the +5-point promotion threshold.
No independent same-work labels, reciprocal consent, randomized exposure, transfer outcomes, or unwanted-contact measure.

decision: Keep the goal active. The evidence supports a governed PostgreSQL-first research architecture and bounded mechanics, but does not support completion of enterprise causal, CMU, or Aurora claims.
